study_identification_part.si_4_title: Parsing the heterogeneity of brain-symptom associations in autism spectrum disorder via random forest with homogeneous canonical correlation

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE (I+II) refers to the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) data used in this study.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging data from the Autism Brain Imaging Database Exchange (ABIDE) (NTDC = 1146) were used to generate a normative model to map brain structure deviations of cases (NASD = 571).
